# Data and model facts (generated by scripts/project_facts.py)

## Sudan data

- Raw file: 2528 rows. Daily series: 2908 rows, of which 1425 observed.

## SDG/USD

- First observation 2015-01-06: 8.38; last 2022-12-22: 539.60; peak 2022-03-16: 601.70.
- USD value of the pound lost, first → last observation (7.96 years): 98.4%; first → peak: 98.6%.
- Between consecutive observed rows (1424 steps), SDG/USD is unchanged in 78; median absolute step 0.63%. Zero-change days in the daily series therefore come mostly from forward-filling days without a quote.
- Across the 404-day gap: 79.06 (2019-11-25) → 231.56 (2021-01-02); the data do not show when inside the gap it moved.
- Largest steps between consecutive observations after the gap: 454.62 (2022-03-07) → 567.80 (2022-03-09); 289.06 (2021-03-10) → 357.93 (2021-03-22).

## Price and exchange rate (OLS on the observed rows)

- On the 1425 observed rows: R² of log price on log SDG/USD 0.9976; R² of log price on log USD/oz 0.8238.

## Test range vs training range (70/15/15 split)

- Sudan: training maximum 3270 SDG/g (training ends 2020-08-01); test targets 20818–32525 SDG/g = 6.4–9.9× the training maximum.
- Global: 513 of 917 test days above the training maximum 1888.70 USD/oz (gold_close).

- Trained models: 34,817–224,734 parameters; PatchTST 34,817–220,894.
- Chronos: mini 20,456,192, small 46,154,240.
